[BSP reconstruction 0041e870]
Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Direct callee of BSP_Application_Initialize (0073d410); analysis-only packet app_initialize_map, no reconstruction. 1230 callers; body is BSP_NativeString_Resize followed by _memcpy. Used throughout BSP_Application_Initialize to build the mount roots and the datatable paths immediately before each consuming call. Evidence: docs/APP_INITIALIZE_MAP.md; reports/app_initialize_map.json.

[BSP reconstruction 0041e870] update
Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet app_init_alloc_string_helpers, assembly-verified. __thiscall, ECX 8-byte string, stack (const char* text), RET 4, returns this in EAX. This is a CONSTRUCTOR body, not an assignment: 0041e87a zeroes length and data before doing anything, so calling it on a live string abandons that buffer. strlen inline, then BSP_NativeString_Resize(len, preserve=1), then, only if data is non-null, memcpy of len+1 bytes, which rewrites the terminator Resize already placed. An empty text leaves data null because Resize(0) from length 0 is a no-op. 1230 callers. The name is kept for continuity with docs/APP_INITIALIZE_MAP.md; BSP_NativeString_ConstructFromCString would describe it better. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_ALLOC_STRINGS.md.
